summary.text: Chuck Horn is an independent candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 36 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with incumbent Republican Andrea White and Democrat Rose Lounsbury.
Ballotpedia describes him as a former attorney.

paragraphs.text: Chuck Horn previously sought the Democratic nomination for the same District 36 seat, losing the March 19, 2024 primary to Rose Lounsbury, 73.7 percent to 26.3 percent.
